mapper.sql: id, realm_id, operator_id, operator_name, action, description, target_type, target_id, ip, occurred_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_audit_log(realm_id, operator_id, operator_name, action, description, target_type, target_id, ip, occurred_time) VALUES (#{realmId}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, #{action}, #{description}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{ip}, COALESCE(#{occurredTime}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT realm_id FROM iam_audit_log WHERE occurred_time < #{cutoff} AND realm_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY realm_id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM iam_audit_log WHERE realm_id = #{realmId} AND occurred_time < #{cutoff}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM iam_audit_log WHERE realm_id = #{realmId} AND occurred_time < #{cutoff}
